Title: BROCK Sub-Agent Created
Summary: BROCK initialized as REGINALD sub-agent for BDC/private credit deep monitoring. Tracks hidden leverage ($142B unfunded bank commitments), PIK trends, NAV discounts, dividend sustainability. Parent thesis: BDC stress = procyclical bank stress amplifier.

Title: Sector NAV Baseline
Summary: BDC sector NAV discount at -16% avg (-21% median). Massive swing from +6% premium in Feb 2025. Market pricing ~32% defaults vs 1-3% actual non-accruals. Disconnect suggests either market wrong or hidden stress not yet recognized.

Title: Crisis Names Identified
Summary: PSEC at -57% discount (RED), FSK at -34% (ORANGE). Both in crisis territory. PSEC is largest discount in sector, dividend sustainability questioned. FSK has $15B size and significant bank credit line exposure.

Title: Golub PIK Spike Documented
Summary: Golub Capital (GBDC) Q3 2025 10-Q shows PIK interest spike of 173% YoY. This is the clearest signal of floating-rate borrower stress. Golub cut dividend -15% in Sept 2025. Pattern: PIK rises → cash NII falls → dividend cut → market panic.

Title: Bank Credit Line Exposure
Summary: Inherited from REGINALD: CFG has $10-11B fund finance / BDC exposure. VLY and ZION also have PE sub-line exposure. When BDCs draw lines, these banks face liquidity drain. This is the transmission mechanism to regional bank stress.
